# Coditech (The Hellspires)

> AI-Powered Code Debugger & Interactive Error Solver for systems developers, C programmers, and software engineers.

- Platform URL: https://thehellspires.vercel.app/
- Author / Creator: Anmol Kumar (https://portfolio.anmolkumar.workers.dev/)
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Anmolop97/TheHellspires

## Core Capabilities
- Diagnostics: Segmentation fault analysis, memory leak detection, compiler error explanation
- Stacks Supported: C, C++, Systems Architecture, Linux CLI, Modern Web
- Purpose: Root-cause debugging education, memory inspection, and real-time development acceleration
